# TriZOD dataset: column dictionary

<!-- Generated by `scripts/build_parquet_dataset.py --write-column-dictionary docs/dataset/columns.md` from `COLUMNS` and `COLUMN_DOCS`. Do not edit by hand: tests/test_column_dictionary.py fails when it differs. -->

`trizod_dataset.parquet` has 85 columns, one row per scored protein chain, in this order. Per-residue columns are lists aligned 1:1 to `sequence`. A residue is scored where `mask` is true; `gscores` and `zscores` are NaN exactly where it is false (999 in the UdonPred view and the deploy FASTA). A shift count k > 0 does not imply a score. Null means unknown or not recorded, never a default. *Nullable* says whether a null can occur in the release (every Arrow field is declared nullable). The table metadata (`pyarrow.parquet.read_schema(path).metadata`) restates the semantics of the flag columns, the cuts and the provenance. *scores.json* below is the build-internal per-tier score file each row was read from (`label_tier_source`); it is not shipped.

| # | Column | Arrow type | Nullable | Meaning | Null / NaN rule |
|--:|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `id` | `string` | no | Chain ID `entryID_stID_entityAssemID_entityID`: BMRB entry, assigned chemical-shift list, entity assembly and entity. Unique per row; the join key of every view and of `trizod_shifts.parquet` | never null |
| 2 | `entry_id` | `string` | no | BMRB entry ID, a string (the sort key: '10001' < '979') | never null |
| 3 | `entity_id` | `string` | no | BMRB `_Entity.ID` of the chain | never null |
| 4 | `entity_assem_id` | `string` | no | BMRB `_Entity_assembly.ID` of the chain | never null |
| 5 | `st_id` | `string` | no | BMRB `_Assigned_chem_shift_list.ID` the labels are scored from | never null |
| 6 | `entity_name` | `string` | yes | `_Entity.Name` | null when the entry names no entity |
| 7 | `sequence` | `string` | no | One-letter sequence as scored: the 20 standard residues plus X, U and Z (metadata `sequence_alphabet`). Every per-residue list is aligned 1:1 to it | never null |
| 8 | `length` | `int32` | no | Length of `sequence` | never null |
| 9 | `gscores` | `list<float32>` | no | Per-residue TriZOD G-score, 0–1, higher = more disordered: THE label. Cuts (metadata `cuts`): ordered G < 0.15, disordered G ≥ 0.35, confidently disordered G ≥ 0.70 | list never null, as long as `sequence`; element NaN exactly where `mask` is false |
| 10 | `zscores` | `list<float32>` | no | Per-residue CheZOD Z-score (unbounded; grows with the shift count k) | list never null, as long as `sequence`; element NaN exactly where `mask` is false |
| 11 | `k` | `list<int32>` | no | Per-residue number of backbone chemical shifts behind the residue's score (its own and its neighbours'); 0 = none. k > 0 does not imply a score. k ≥ 10 is a conventional reliability cut (metadata `cuts`) | list never null, as long as `sequence`; elements never null (0 where no shift) |
| 12 | `mask` | `list<bool>` | no | Per-residue: true iff the residue is scored, i.e. its G (and Z) is finite. Where false, G and Z are NaN here and 999 in the UdonPred view and the deploy FASTA. Mask on this column, not on k | list never null, as long as `sequence`; elements never null |
| 13 | `n_scored` | `int32` | no | Number of scored residues, `sum(mask)` | never null |
| 14 | `split` | `string` | no | train / redundant / test_trizod / test_retired / test_chezod117 / excluded (metadata `split_values`, `test_retired_semantics`) | never null |
| 15 | `train_tier` | `string` | yes | Strictest tier at which the chain is a training representative. The training set of tier T is `split == 'train'` and `train_tier` at T or stricter (tiers nest: unfiltered ⊃ tolerant ⊃ moderate ⊃ strict) | null unless `split == 'train'` |
| 16 | `pool_tier` | `string` | yes | Strictest tier whose redundancy-reduction pool contains the chain | null when the chain is in no tier's redundancy-reduction pool |
| 17 | `cluster_repr` | `string` | yes | Training representative heading the chain's 50 %/80 % mmseqs cluster | null when the chain is in no tier's redundancy-reduction pool |
| 18 | `quality` | `float64` | yes | Quality score that picked the cluster representative: tier rank × 10⁶ + backbone positions × backbone atom types − max \|POTENCI residual\| | null when the chain is in no tier's redundancy-reduction pool |
| 19 | `exp_method` | `string` | yes | `_Entry.Experimental_method` | null when the entry does not declare it |
| 20 | `exp_method_subtype` | `string` | yes | `_Entry.Experimental_method_subtype` (e.g. SOLUTION) | null when the entry does not declare it (about a quarter of BMRB) |
| 21 | `ph` | `float32` | yes | Sample pH from the shift list's sample condition list. A pH* (meter) reading is used as is; a pD is converted to pD − 0.4 (`known_issues.tsv` lists the chains). 7.0 imputed where none was deposited, except at strict, which requires it | null when not deposited and not imputed, or outside the valid range |
| 22 | `temperature` | `float32` | yes | Sample temperature in K; 298 K imputed where none was deposited or a 273 K placeholder was read as not deposited (`temperature_placeholder`) | null when not deposited and not imputed |
| 23 | `ionic_strength` | `float32` | yes | Sample ionic strength in M as deposited; 0.1 M imputed where none was deposited, except at strict | null when not deposited and not imputed, or invalid (negative) |
| 24 | `total_bbshifts` | `int32` | yes | Backbone shifts (H, HA, HB, C, CA, CB, N) deposited on the chain, terminal residues not counted | null when the shifts could not be mapped onto the sequence |
| 25 | `bbshift_positions_post` | `int32` | yes | Residues with at least one backbone shift used in the score | null when the chain was not scored |
| 26 | `bbshift_types_post` | `int32` | yes | Backbone atom types with shifts used in the score (at most 7) | null when the chain was not scored |
| 27 | `citation_title` | `string` | yes | Title of the entry's primary citation | null when none deposited |
| 28 | `citation_doi` | `string` | yes | DOI of the entry's primary citation | null when none deposited |
| 29 | `off_C_sigma` | `float32` | yes | POTENCI/AIC residual referencing offset of the carbonyl C (C) shifts, in multiples of the per-atom POTENCI RMSD REFINED_WEIGHTS[C] = 0.1846 ppm -- NOT ppm. `--max-offset` is compared against it. 0.0 where no offset was applied, including every chain without a C shift (nothing to correct, not a measured zero) | null where the row's record (`label_tier_source` tolerant) rejected atom type C by `--max-offset` and masked it out of the score; `lacs_off_C_ppm` is still set there |
| 30 | `off_CA_sigma` | `float32` | yes | POTENCI/AIC residual referencing offset of the Cα (CA) shifts, in multiples of the per-atom POTENCI RMSD REFINED_WEIGHTS[CA] = 0.1982 ppm -- NOT ppm. `--max-offset` is compared against it. 0.0 where no offset was applied, including every chain without a CA shift (nothing to correct, not a measured zero) | null where the row's record (`label_tier_source` tolerant) rejected atom type CA by `--max-offset` and masked it out of the score; `lacs_off_CA_ppm` is still set there |
| 31 | `off_CB_sigma` | `float32` | yes | POTENCI/AIC residual referencing offset of the Cβ (CB) shifts, in multiples of the per-atom POTENCI RMSD REFINED_WEIGHTS[CB] = 0.1544 ppm -- NOT ppm. `--max-offset` is compared against it. 0.0 where no offset was applied, including every chain without a CB shift (nothing to correct, not a measured zero) | null where the row's record (`label_tier_source` tolerant) rejected atom type CB by `--max-offset` and masked it out of the score; `lacs_off_CB_ppm` is still set there |
| 32 | `off_H_sigma` | `float32` | yes | POTENCI/AIC residual referencing offset of the amide H (H) shifts, in multiples of the per-atom POTENCI RMSD REFINED_WEIGHTS[H] = 0.06708 ppm -- NOT ppm. `--max-offset` is compared against it. 0.0 where no offset was applied, including every chain without a H shift (nothing to correct, not a measured zero) | null where the row's record (`label_tier_source` tolerant) rejected atom type H by `--max-offset` and masked it out of the score; `lacs_off_H_ppm` is still set there |
| 33 | `off_HA_sigma` | `float32` | yes | POTENCI/AIC residual referencing offset of the Hα (HA) shifts, in multiples of the per-atom POTENCI RMSD REFINED_WEIGHTS[HA] = 0.02631 ppm -- NOT ppm. `--max-offset` is compared against it. 0.0 where no offset was applied, including every chain without a HA shift (nothing to correct, not a measured zero) | null where the row's record (`label_tier_source` tolerant) rejected atom type HA by `--max-offset` and masked it out of the score; `lacs_off_HA_ppm` is still set there |
| 34 | `off_HB_sigma` | `float32` | yes | POTENCI/AIC residual referencing offset of the Hβ (HB) shifts, in multiples of the per-atom POTENCI RMSD REFINED_WEIGHTS[HB] = 0.02154 ppm -- NOT ppm. `--max-offset` is compared against it. 0.0 where no offset was applied, including every chain without a HB shift (nothing to correct, not a measured zero) | null where the row's record (`label_tier_source` tolerant) rejected atom type HB by `--max-offset` and masked it out of the score; `lacs_off_HB_ppm` is still set there |
| 35 | `off_N_sigma` | `float32` | yes | POTENCI/AIC residual referencing offset of the amide N (N) shifts, in multiples of the per-atom POTENCI RMSD REFINED_WEIGHTS[N] = 0.4722 ppm -- NOT ppm. `--max-offset` is compared against it. 0.0 where no offset was applied, including every chain without a N shift (nothing to correct, not a measured zero) | null where the row's record (`label_tier_source` tolerant) rejected atom type N by `--max-offset` and masked it out of the score; `lacs_off_N_ppm` is still set there |
| 36 | `lacs_off_C_ppm` | `float32` | yes | LACS referencing offset of the carbonyl C (C) shifts, in ppm. 0.0 where LACS applied none: too few observations, an atom it does not correct, or no C shift in the chain | never null for a scored chain (null only if the build's scores.json record lacks the field) |
| 37 | `lacs_off_CA_ppm` | `float32` | yes | LACS referencing offset of the Cα (CA) shifts, in ppm. 0.0 where LACS applied none: too few observations, an atom it does not correct, or no CA shift in the chain | never null for a scored chain (null only if the build's scores.json record lacks the field) |
| 38 | `lacs_off_CB_ppm` | `float32` | yes | LACS referencing offset of the Cβ (CB) shifts, in ppm. 0.0 where LACS applied none: too few observations, an atom it does not correct, or no CB shift in the chain | never null for a scored chain (null only if the build's scores.json record lacks the field) |
| 39 | `lacs_off_H_ppm` | `float32` | yes | LACS referencing offset of the amide H (H) shifts, in ppm. 0.0 where LACS applied none: too few observations, an atom it does not correct, or no H shift in the chain | never null for a scored chain (null only if the build's scores.json record lacks the field) |
| 40 | `lacs_off_HA_ppm` | `float32` | yes | LACS referencing offset of the Hα (HA) shifts, in ppm. 0.0 where LACS applied none: too few observations, an atom it does not correct, or no HA shift in the chain | never null for a scored chain (null only if the build's scores.json record lacks the field) |
| 41 | `lacs_off_HB_ppm` | `float32` | yes | LACS referencing offset of the Hβ (HB) shifts, in ppm. 0.0 where LACS applied none: too few observations, an atom it does not correct, or no HB shift in the chain | never null for a scored chain (null only if the build's scores.json record lacks the field) |
| 42 | `lacs_off_N_ppm` | `float32` | yes | LACS referencing offset of the amide N (N) shifts, in ppm. 0.0 where LACS applied none: too few observations, an atom it does not correct, or no N shift in the chain | never null for a scored chain (null only if the build's scores.json record lacks the field) |
| 43 | `total_off_C_ppm` | `float64` | yes | Total referencing offset of the carbonyl C (C) shifts in ppm: `lacs_off_C_ppm + off_C_sigma × 0.1846`. Subtract it from a deposited shift to get the shift TriZOD scored (never add the other two columns: different units). 0.0 where no offset was applied, including every chain without a C shift (nothing to correct, not a measured zero) | null exactly where `off_C_sigma` is: null where the row's record (`label_tier_source` tolerant) rejected atom type C by `--max-offset` and masked it out of the score; `lacs_off_C_ppm` is still set there |

Subtract it from a deposited shift to get the shift TriZOD scored (never add the other two columns: different units). 0.0 where no offset was applied, including every chain without a CA shift (nothing to correct, not a measured zero) | null exactly where `off_CA_sigma` is: null where the row's record (`label_tier_source` tolerant) rejected atom type CA by `--max-offset` and masked it out of the score; `lacs_off_CA_ppm` is still set there |

Subtract it from a deposited shift to get the shift TriZOD scored (never add the other two columns: different units). 0.0 where no offset was applied, including every chain without a CB shift (nothing to correct, not a measured zero) | null exactly where `off_CB_sigma` is: null where the row's record (`label_tier_source` tolerant) rejected atom type CB by `--max-offset` and masked it out of the score; `lacs_off_CB_ppm` is still set there |

Subtract it from a deposited shift to get the shift TriZOD scored (never add the other two columns: different units). 0.0 where no offset was applied, including every chain without a H shift (nothing to correct, not a measured zero) | null exactly where `off_H_sigma` is: null where the row's record (`label_tier_source` tolerant) rejected atom type H by `--max-offset` and masked it out of the score; `lacs_off_H_ppm` is still set there |

Subtract it from a deposited shift to get the shift TriZOD scored (never add the other two columns: different units). 0.0 where no offset was applied, including every chain without a HA shift (nothing to correct, not a measured zero) | null exactly where `off_HA_sigma` is: null where the row's record (`label_tier_source` tolerant) rejected atom type HA by `--max-offset` and masked it out of the score; `lacs_off_HA_ppm` is still set there |

Subtract it from a deposited shift to get the shift TriZOD scored (never add the other two columns: different units). 0.0 where no offset was applied, including every chain without a HB shift (nothing to correct, not a measured zero) | null exactly where `off_HB_sigma` is: null where the row's record (`label_tier_source` tolerant) rejected atom type HB by `--max-offset` and masked it out of the score; `lacs_off_HB_ppm` is still set there |

Subtract it from a deposited shift to get the shift TriZOD scored (never add the other two columns: different units). 0.0 where no offset was applied, including every chain without a N shift (nothing to correct, not a measured zero) | null exactly where `off_N_sigma` is: null where the row's record (`label_tier_source` tolerant) rejected atom type N by `--max-offset` and masked it out of the score; `lacs_off_N_ppm` is still set there |
| 50 | `physical_state` | `string` | yes | `_Entity_assembly.Physical_state` of the chain's assembly, lower-cased (native, intrinsically disordered, denatured, …); the tiers deny non-native states | null when not deposited |
| 51 | `cosolvent_evidence` | `bool` | yes | Does the entry name a perturbing cosolvent (urea, guanidinium, TFE, HFIP, DMSO, methanol, ethanol, SDS, …) in its sample components, solvent system or sample text? | null only when the scores.json record lacks the field |
| 52 | `sample_state_evidence` | `string` | yes | solution / solid / unknown, from `_Sample.Type`, `_Experiment.Sample_state` and the experiment names | null only when the scores.json record lacks the field |
| 53 | `membrane_mimetic` | `string` | yes | ';'-joined membrane-mimetic classes recognised in the chain's samples (phospholipid, bicelle, nanodisc, SDS, DPC, CHAPS, …), counted by the class rule or not. Descriptive; the filter reads `membrane_mimetic_sample` | null when none is recognised |
| 54 | `n_entities` | `int32` | yes | Distinct `_Entity` records of the entry (a homodimer is 1) | null when the entry has no composition record |
| 55 | `has_non_polymer` | `bool` | yes | The entry has a non-polymer entity | null when the entry has no composition record |
| 56 | `has_nucleic` | `bool` | yes | The entry has a DNA/RNA entity | null when the entry has no composition record |
| 57 | `has_metal` | `bool` | yes | The entry has a metal (ion or cofactor) | null when the entry has no composition record |
| 58 | `has_metal_ion` | `bool` | yes | The entry has a free metal ion | null when the entry has no composition record |
| 59 | `has_metal_cofactor` | `bool` | yes | The entry has a metal-containing cofactor | null when the entry has no composition record |
| 60 | `has_water` | `bool` | yes | The entry lists a water entity (not counted as a member) | null when the entry has no composition record |
| 61 | `has_other_ligand` | `bool` | yes | The entry has another non-polymer ligand | null when the entry has no composition record |
| 62 | `metal_comp_ids` | `list<string>` | yes | Chemical-component IDs of the metals (empty list: none) | null when the entry has no composition record |
| 63 | `ligand_comp_ids` | `list<string>` | yes | Chemical-component IDs of the ligands (empty list: none) | null when the entry has no composition record |
| 64 | `ligand_names` | `list<string>` | yes | Names of the ligands (empty list: none) | null when the entry has no composition record |
| 65 | `multi_protein_assembly` | `bool` | yes | An assembly holds more than one distinct protein entity | null when the entry has no composition record |
| 66 | `n_entity_assembly_rows` | `int32` | yes | `_Entity_assembly` rows of the chain's entity (raw copy count; inflated by alternative-conformer depositions) | null when the entry has no composition record |
| 67 | `n_copies` | `int32` | yes | Conservative lower bound on the copies of the entity in an assembly (metadata `n_copies_semantics`) | null when the entry has no composition record, or the classifier errored on it |
| 68 | `has_conformational_isomer` | `bool` | yes | Assembly rows name conformers (cis/trans, major/minor, …), so `n_entity_assembly_rows` over-counts copies | null when the entry has no composition record |
| 69 | `is_bound` | `bool` | yes | Bound-complex verdict of `trizod dataset build` (a second protein, a ligand, nucleic acid or metal in an assembly); bound entries are not in any training pool | null when the entry has no composition record |
| 70 | `label_tier` | `string` | yes | Strictest tier whose pool still contains the pinned test sequence: strict for every test_trizod row; for a test_retired row any tier, strict where it was retired for another reason than not_strict | null unless `split` is test_trizod or test_retired |
| 71 | `pressure_bar` | `float32` | yes | Sample pressure in bar from the shift list's sample condition list, converted from the deposited unit | null when not recorded or the unit is unknown (passes as ambient) |
| 72 | `label_tier_source` | `string` | no | Tier whose scores.json record supplied the row's labels and offsets (metadata `label_source`) | never null |
| 73 | `xrefs` | `list<struct<db: string, accession: string, source: string, identity: float32, coverage: float32, origin: string, raw_db: string, raw_accession: string, details: string>>` | yes | Every UniProt / PDB link of the chain, a struct (db, accession, source, identity, coverage, origin, raw_db, raw_accession, details); metadata `xrefs_semantics` | null when the entry was not read; empty when it declares no link |
| 74 | `uniprot_ids` | `list<string>` | yes | The chain's own UniProt accessions at its best evidence level (author, else sifts, else 100 %/100 % hits) | null when the entry was not read; empty when there is none |
| 75 | `uniprot_source` | `string` | yes | Evidence level of `uniprot_ids`: author / sifts / unspecified / blast | null when `uniprot_ids` is empty or the entry was not read |
| 76 | `pdb_ids` | `list<string>` | yes | Distinct PDB IDs from `exact` and `author` links | null when the entry was not read; empty when there is none |
| 77 | `membrane_mimetic_sample` | `bool` | yes | Class-rule verdict: the chain's sample is a membrane mimetic (metadata `membrane_mimetic_sample_semantics`); excluded from moderate and strict. False also when no sample component could be read | null only if the build's scores.json record lacks the field |
| 78 | `temperature_placeholder` | `bool` | yes | The deposited temperature was exactly 273 K with no stated 0 °C and was read as not deposited: the chain is scored at the 298 K default and strict excludes it | null only if the build's scores.json record lacks the field |
| 79 | `high_pressure` | `bool` | yes | `pressure_bar >= 400`: the ceiling of the tolerant, moderate and strict tiers | null when no pressure was recorded or its unit is missing or unknown (passes as ambient): filter with `high_pressure IS NOT TRUE`, not `== False` |
| 80 | `chezod117_overlap` | `bool` | yes | The chain meets the leakage criterion (>= 30 % identity over >= 80 % of the test chain or the training chain (at least one of the two), >= 27 bits, either search direction, every reported alignment (--alt-ali 10)) against at least one sequence of CheZOD117 (the released chains plus the 117 original sequences SETH published). Benchmark a predictor trained on that set on the test chains where it is false | null when the overlap was not computed |
| 81 | `chezod1325_overlap` | `bool` | yes | The chain meets the leakage criterion (>= 30 % identity over >= 80 % of the test chain or the training chain (at least one of the two), >= 27 bits, either search direction, every reported alignment (--alt-ali 10)) against at least one sequence of CheZOD1325 (allseqs1325, ODiNPred's training set). Benchmark a predictor trained on that set on the test chains where it is false | null when the overlap was not computed |
| 82 | `chezod1174_overlap` | `bool` | yes | The chain meets the leakage criterion (>= 30 % identity over >= 80 % of the test chain or the training chain (at least one of the two), >= 27 bits, either search direction, every reported alignment (--alt-ali 10)) against at least one sequence of CheZOD1174 (the SETH and ADOPT training set). Benchmark a predictor trained on that set on the test chains where it is false | null when the overlap was not computed |
| 83 | `retired_reason` | `string` | yes | Why a pinned test chain was retired: not_strict: it no longer meets the strict tier (mostly the 2026-11 condition rules); chezod117_overlap: it meets the leakage criterion against a CheZOD117 sequence, so the two test sets would overlap; within_test_duplicate: it is the shorter chain of a pair of test chains at >= 50 % identity over >= 80 % of either chain; shared_construct: a reviewed decision, not a rule: it meets no leakage criterion on its deposited sequence, but is a near-copy of training chains once its expression tag or fusion partner is set aside, so its labels are largely training labels (trizod/dataset/data/test_retirements.tsv of the code repository lists the chains, partners and evidence) (metadata `test_retired_semantics`) | null unless `split == 'test_retired'` |
| 84 | `sequence_group` | `string` | no | Same-sequence link: `seq-` + the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the upper-case `sequence`, shared by every chain whose `sequence` is identical, in every split (`split` says which chain is test). A function of the sequence alone, so stable across releases. Overlay replicate measurements with `groupby("sequence_group")`: their per-residue lists align position by position. Other constructs of the same protein (tag, truncation, mutant) usually share `uniprot_ids` but not `sequence_group`; overlaying them needs a residue alignment, which the release does not provide (metadata `sequence_group_semantics`) | never null |
| 85 | `sequence_group_size` | `int32` | no | Number of chains of this release, across every split, in the chain's `sequence_group`; 1 = no other chain has this sequence | never null |
